name: design-agent-skills
description: Design skills for Codex, from product context and interface reviews to approved decisions and developer handoff.

interface.longDescription: DAS helps Codex reconstruct product context, audit interfaces, explore design alternatives, and prepare a developer handoff. It carries approved choices into contracts and checks implementation against them. You choose material product changes. Version 0.1.0 supports the documented Codex app and CLI workflows. Claude support is under development and is not part of this release.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface and recommend what to change.
Explore design directions for this product.
Check the implementation against the approved design.
